The *Parittattika* (Patthana 13.12) is an Abhidhamma treatise forming part of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Designated as a leaf section in the canonical structural tree, the text systematically investigates conditional relations (*paccaya*) pertaining to the *paritta* ("limited" or "minor") triad of the Abhidhamma *mātikā* [SuttaCentral]. No individual English title or translation is recorded for this section on SuttaCentral, and no references to it were identified in the consulted secondary literature [SuttaCentral].
